title: His day job at the pressing shop
summary: He worked part-time pressing clothes three days a week.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Did you keep your day job or give it up then later when you started working so much?

Well, I happened not to be working then. I had a job, but it was a part-time job. I was pressing, real pressing shop. And I only worked three days a week. And that was on the corner of Royal and Espanol.
